Use the built-in session pin instead."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 📌 dsh-session-pin
- **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profil"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"e web add dsh-session-pin` (counts toward the deepseek1024.com install ranking)."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 🪦 **RETIRED — compatibility updates stopped as of 2026-10-05.** This capability is now **implement"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ed by the official harness itself**: DeepSeek Harness **ships session pinning natively** — the sessi"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"on row menu and hover button in `dsh-client-ui-workspace` pin and unpin a session, the pin set persi"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"sts on the Host, and pinned rows reorder among themselves, all mounted in the default Web bundle. Wh"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"at remained unique here was only the visual layer (per-pin row colours, boards, tags, saved views). "},{"id":"p3s6","text":"👉 **Use the built-in session pin instead.** This repository stays public for reference, but it will "},{"id":"p3s7","text":"not track further host changes."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with per-pin row colors.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*A dual-face (host + browser) plugin: two pin levels, an 8-color swatch per pin, and a navigation or"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ganizer — boards, tags, saved views, health summaries, and `/goto`.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Official repository.** This is the only official repository of dsh-session-pin, maintained by Pe"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rryLink. Same-name repositories under other accounts are not affiliated."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · Español · Português · हिन्दी"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Surface | Status |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (GitHub tag; verified 2026-09-22: dual-ruler typec"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"heck + unit/composition suites + static seam checks; browser pass pending maintainer). npm dependenc"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y line `0.1.7-rc.2`, peers `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.1.5-alpha.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.1.6-0 <0.2.0 \|"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"\| >=0.1.7-0 <0.2.0`. |
| Node | `>= 22` (development floor) |
| Platforms | Web GUI (dual-face: hos"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"t + browser) |
| Model | Any (UI-only — no model traffic, no session events) |
| `session/pin` event"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s | Pre-flight-gated: written only when the host's runtime event vocabulary knows the type (the alph"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"a-line append can no longer stamp the `ignorable` marker, so the vocabulary is the single gate signa"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"l — adapted 2026-09-18); otherwise the projection degrades to the settings cache and one warning fir"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"es before the first write. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`dsh-session-pin` keeps the conversations that matter at the top of the sidebar and colors them so y"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ou can find them at a glance:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Two pin levels** — pin whole workspaces and individual sessions; a pinned workspace moves to the"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" front of the workspace list and a pinned session to the front of its account.
- **Per-pin row color"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s** — a swatch after each pin cycles an 8-color preset palette (Shift+click clears); the row gets a "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"left accent bar plus a translucent tint.
- **Four pin surfaces** — a hover `[pin][swatch]` pair on e"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"very row, a pin toggle in the session header, a sidebar foot action with a pinned panel, and per-bro"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"wser durable pinning that keeps pins and colors across restarts.
- **Click-to-open** — clicking a pi"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"nned row in the sidebar or the pinned panel opens the session in the current window (the same seam `"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"/goto` uses); both navigate through the host's session-retain channel on the alpha line.
- **Zero co"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"re changes** — a standalone plugin for the stock DSH Web GUI; every surface degrades gracefully on o"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"a standalone plugin for the stock DSH Web GUI; every surface degrades gracefully on older baselines."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`) — declares the `session-pin` settings form as the plugin's own live"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" Config: the two pinned id lists, the two color maps, the organizer state, and the host policy (`max"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"Pins`/`reorderOnLoad`/`pruneStale` plus the five feature switches) are all `.volatile()` fields. On "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"the `0.1.7` settings contract a form's namespace is the local id of its profile entry, so the bundle"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" patch's `id: session-pin` row names the form, the Plugins page edits it, and accepted edits are hot"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"-applied to the running plugin; no session events, no model traffic.
- **Browser half** (`src/client"},{"id":"p16s7","text":".ts`) — assembles a framework-free `PinStore` (the host half's live Config form read through `ctx.co"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"nfigForms.get(entryId)`, degrading to a versioned `localStorage` document with cross-tab sync), a `P"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"inController` (two-level toggle / color cycle / prune / reorder state machine), and the UI: the row "},{"id":"p16s10","text":"overlay, the optional row-slot registration, the header toggle, the sidebar foot action, and the pin"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"ned panel. Ordering goes through `ctx.workspaces`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **UI-only.** No model-visible effects, no network, no subprocesses; every surface degrades gracefu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lly on older baselines.
- **Durable, bounded state.** Pins and colors are pruned with deleted entiti"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"es (`pruneStale`); `maxPins` caps the pinned count per level.
- **Read-only health.** The health sum"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"mary derives counts and directions from the public session snapshot and writes nothing back."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Persistence scope** — the log-backed canonical residence is opt-in (`enableLogBacking`, fail-clo"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"sed default off) and its live read loop requires builds that emit the `session/pin` event (the upstr"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"eam `session.setPinned` RPC); on baselines without it, pins and colors fall back to the plugin's `se"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ssion-pin` settings form, then to browser-local `localStorage`. On hosts whose event vocabulary does"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" not know the type, the pre-flight gate disables log appends entirely (the fail-closed read path wou"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ld reject such logs), so the projection degrades to the settings cache there.
- **Ordering scope** —"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" the pinned position is stable only under **Manual** order; under **Updated** order the core's activ"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"ity promotion re-fronts active sessions, and `reorderOnLoad` re-asserts the prefixes on load.
- **Re"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"mote browsers** — settings RPCs are loopback-only on the baseline; remote browsers fall back to brow"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"ser-local `localStorage`.
- **Row badge fallback** — where the upstream row slot is unavailable, ses"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"sion rows are matched by title text; with duplicate titles the badge shows on every matching row and"},{"id":"p20s12","text":" toggles the first match (cosmetic).
- **Row DOM dependency** — the overlay relies on the core rows'"},{"id":"p20s13","text":" `role="treeitem"` structure and must follow upstream UI changes."}],"truncated":true}
